title: CBSE Class 9 - SST (Geography)
subtitle: India - Size and Location
description: Online practice test containing 100 high-yield objective MCQs for Class 9 India - Size and Location.

questions.q: India lies entirely in which hemisphere?
What is the main land latitudinal extent of India?
What is the longitudinal extent of India?
Which important latitude divides India into almost two equal parts?
Which meridian is chosen as the Standard Meridian of India?
Indian Standard Time (IST) is ahead of Greenwich Mean Time (GMT) by:
What is the total land area of India?
India's total geographical area accounts for what percentage of total geographical area of the world?
India is the _____ largest country in the world in terms of land area.
What is the total length of the land boundary of India?
What is the total length of coastline of mainland including Andaman & Nicobar and Lakshadweep islands?
What is the time lag between Gujarat in the west and Arunachal Pradesh in the east?
Which island group of India lies in the Arabian Sea?
Which island group of India lies in the Bay of Bengal?
The southernmost point of the Indian Union which got submerged under sea water during 2004 Tsunami is:
The opening of which canal in 1869 reduced India's distance from Europe by 7,000 km?
Which narrow channel of sea formed by Palk Strait and Gulf of Mannar separates Sri Lanka from India?
o: Palk Strait and Gulf of Mannar
